name: campus-swap
description: Student-only marketplace for textbooks, dorm gear and tickets

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @campus-swap/shared && npm run build --workspace @campus-swap/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @campus-swap/shared && npm run export:web --workspace @campus-swap/mobile
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace @campus-swap/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace @campus-swap/api && npm run build --workspace @campus-swap/api
